title: Safety data sources: no major access changes
summary: As of 28 August 2026, the public safety-information services available in Device Safety Intelligence remain available. We found no major platform change that is expected to affect data freshness or availability.
updates: FDA device reports and recalls: no significant change to the public information services.
European and UK safety notices: no significant change to the BfArM, Swissmedic, MHRA, AEMPS, or ANSM public services.
Australia, Canada, Brazil, Japan, and NMPA English: no significant change to the public information services.
no_major_changes: All currently available safety data sources remain under regular monitoring.
